newsitem.title: UK: LPC - NatWest said to shelve loan for Russian firm.
newsitem.headline: LPC - NatWest said to shelve loan for Russian firm.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 9 (LPC) - NatWest Markets has postponed its $500 million loan agreement with Russian diamond producer Almazy Rossi-Sakha (ARS), according to a banker close to the deal.

The banker said NatWest has shelved the loan until Russian authorities and the De Beers diamond group are able to conclude talks on an expired marketing agreement. ARS, De Beers negotiating partner, is Russia's near-monopoly producer.
The $500 million loan was to finance company exploration and development. NatWest was given the mandate to arrange the credit in July.
